description: Place orders in one explicit mode. mode:live executes real-money orders; mode:paper simulates every item. Mixed or implicit modes are rejected. The schema accepts up to 50 items, but the active tier's order-per-minute allowance applies to the entire batch (10 on free). Processing stops before later live items after the first failure. Pass idempotency_key to make a retry safe.

idempotency_key.description: Optional retry-safety key. Auto-generated when omitted.

mode.description: Required batch mode: live or paper.

orders.description: Orders: {instrument, side, size_usd, type?, limit_price?, allow_leverage?}.

allow_leverage.description: Set true only after reviewing collateral. Omitted or false blocks orders whose notional exceeds free Hyperliquid collateral.

instrument.description: Instrument, e.g. BTC, NVDA, lighter:ETH, option:BTC-20260711-70000-C, pm:<slug>.

limit_price.description: Optional paper limit price. For live Polymarket market/FOK orders, this is an explicit maximum buy price or minimum sell price that Felix must match exactly; type:"limit" remains paper-only.

max_round_trip_loss_pct.description: Maximum projected immediate round-trip loss for live Derive orders. Defaults to the server safety threshold.

reduce_only.description: Only reduce an existing live position when supported.

size_usd.description: Dollar notional to spend or trade.

type.description: market|limit. Live supports market only; limit is paper-simulation only.

name: place_batch_orders
